description:
Welcome to The Jubilee! A modern studio located only 7-10 mins to Downton Nashville, BNA, and many of the city's top attractions including Broadway, Opry Mills and the Country Music Hall of Fame! Equipped with a dedicated work space, fully stocked kitchen, a king bed, a queen sofa bed and 55 and 65-inch TVs! I can't wait to host your getaway to Music City. Please enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located condo!

Guest access
You will have the entire studio to yourself. There is a shared courtyard in the center of the complex, as well as a dog relief area along the back parking lot.
